papers.title: FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.desc: Long-horizon tasks require LLM agents to continually draw on information from earlier interactions.

papers.title: EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents
papers.desc: Training LLM agents to interact with users over multiple turns is challenging because the learning signal depends not only on the agent, but also on the user simulator and environment, which jointly shape the agent's experience.

papers.title: On the Fragility of Tasks under Composition: Implicit Budgeting in Language Models
papers.desc: Modern language models are increasingly asked to handle several tasks within a single prompt.

papers.title: PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements
papers.desc: Recent video generation models produce visually compelling outputs, yet their physical plausibility remains poorly measured.

papers.title: OverSeer: Multi-Agent World Models Beyond What Agents See
papers.desc: Despite the success of video world models, extending them to multiple agents is difficult because it requires generating several agent-specific video streams that are consistent in time and between agents.

papers.title: HRoPE: Homography Relative Positional Encoding
papers.desc: Geometric Relative Positional Encoding has become the primary mechanism for injecting spatial inductive biases into multi-view transformers.

papers.title: PhysLDM: Latent Diffusion for High-Fidelity Deformable Simulation
papers.desc: Neural simulation of high-fidelity deformable bodies is a foundational challenge in computer graphics and physical AI.

papers.title: On the Tip of the Tongue: First-Token Cueing as a Behavioral Probe of Recall Failures in LLMs
papers.desc: Large language models often answer factual questions incorrectly in closed-book settings, and such errors are usually attributed to missing knowledge.

papers.title: Slot-JEPA: Object-Structured Prediction Interfaces for Latent World Models
papers.desc: As a prototypical latent world model, Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provide strong semantic representations.

papers.title: BiDex-100: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Across 100+ Simulation Tasks
papers.desc: Bimanual manipulation with dexterous hands has attracted growing attention in research on robotic action models.

papers.title: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model
papers.desc: Training coding agents typically updates the policy while keeping the harness fixed.

papers.title: Axiomatic World Modeling for Physics Reasoning
papers.desc: Recent research-level physics-reasoning benchmarks for LLMs reveal a failure mode that lies not in knowledge or execution, but in modeling the world being reasoned about.

papers.title: Self-Credit: Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Agentic RL via Intra-group Rescaling
papers.desc: LLM agents are commonly trained with RLVR, but the sparse nature of typical RLVR rewards makes credit assignment challenging, especially for long-horizon tasks.

papers.title: VideoMaMa++: Temporally Consistent Video Matting via Preserve-and-Refine Token
papers.desc: Diffusion-based video matting has recently emerged as a leading approach, leveraging video diffusion priors from internet-scale pretraining to achieve strong zero-shot generalization from limited synthetic data.

papers.title: World Models with Configurable Perception
papers.desc: Real-world observations are noisy and often contain excessive task-irrelevant information.
